editorial.blurb: Uvae Kitchen and Wine Bar is a thoughtful neighborhood gem in Andersonville where an impressive wine program and seasonal American small plates create the perfect evening out.
editorial.insiderTip: Order wine by the pour—they offer 3, 6, or 9-ounce sizes—and ask your server about seasonal specials; the menu rotates regularly and staff are knowledgeable about pairings.
signatureDishes: Fried artichoke with chili oil, citrus, and pecorino sauce
Black cod with miso, cucumber salad, and crispy rice cake
Burrata with marinated strawberries, basil, lavender, and pistachios
